newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar closes lower in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar closes lower in dull trade.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar finished lower against the greenback on Tuesday in narrow-range trade, and dealers expected the rate to stay at the current levels.

The local unit ended at T$27.495 against Monday's T$27.487 close. Turnover was US$174.5 million. The Taiwan dollar fell to an intra-day low of T$27.498 at one stage to respond the U.S. dollar's strength overseas. But a continued inflow of foreign equity funds offset the fall. "It is really boring, the Taiwan dollar has been in a consolidation for months," said one dealer. A range of T$27.48-50 was seen for Wednesday.- A. Hung(5080815)
